extraction.name: NWPU-RESISC45
extraction.description: A large-scale benchmark dataset for remote sensing image scene classification, containing 31,500 images covering 45 scene classes with 700 images per class. The dataset is designed to address limitations of existing datasets, including small scale, lack of image variations, and saturation of accuracy. It features high within-class diversity and between-class similarity, with images selected under various weather, seasons, illumination conditions, imaging conditions, and scales.
extraction.creator: Gong Cheng, Junwei Han, Xiaoqiang Lu
extraction.citeAs: Cheng, G., Han, J., & Lu, X. (2016). Remote Sensing Image Scene Classification: Benchmark and State of the Art. Proceedings of the IEEE.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by extracting images from Google Earth (Google Inc.), which maps the Earth using satellite imagery, aerial photography, and geographic information systems (GIS). The images were carefully selected to cover a wide range of conditions, including weather, seasons, illumination, imaging conditions, and scales. The dataset includes 31,500 images covering more than 100 countries and regions worldwide.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Google Earth (Google Inc.) satellite imagery, aerial photography, and geographic information systems (GIS)
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were extracted and resized to 256×256 pixels in the RGB color space. Spatial resolution varies from about 30 m to 0.2 m per pixel for most scene classes. The dataset was designed to include high within-class diversity and between-class similarity, with images selected under various conditions to ensure robustness.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset consists of 45 scene classes, each containing 700 images. The classes include land use, land cover, man-made objects, and natural landscapes. The images were annotated by experts in remote sensing image interpretation to ensure accurate classification.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is publicly available and maintained by Northwestern Polytechnical University (NWPU). It is designed as a benchmark for remote sensing image scene classification and is intended for ongoing use by the research community.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset enables the development and evaluation of advanced scene classification algorithms, particularly deep learning-based methods, which can improve intelligent earth observation and land use/land cover classification. This has applications in environmental monitoring, urban planning, and disaster management.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may have biases related to the geographic distribution of images, as it primarily covers images from Google Earth, which may not represent all global regions equally. Additionally, the dataset includes images with high within-class diversity and between-class similarity, which could introduce challenges in classification tasks.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is limited to overhead imagery and does not include ground-level or multi-view data. It may not fully represent all global regions or conditions, and the high within-class diversity and between-class similarity could pose challenges for classification algorithms. The dataset is also limited to RGB color space and does not include other spectral bands.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Benchmarking. The dataset is intended for developing and evaluating remote sensing image scene classification algorithms, particularly deep learning-based methods. It serves as a benchmark for comparing the performance of different algorithms and is useful for research in intelligent earth observation and land use/land cover classification.
